svg.title: VoiceCon, live at voicecon.app
svg.desc: VoiceCon, live at voicecon.app. Android-first AI voice calling: speech is converted on a GPU and delivered over a normal phone call. Illustration of a caller's phone, a GPU chip, a fails-closed lock and the recipient's phone, beside a screenshot of the site. 86 ms median inference per 180 ms block, about 0.5 s server-side delay, 0 ms of audio dropped over a 5-minute run, 336 backend tests. It fails closed: any conversion error ends the call.
